101.Des:
[Skill Build]
Focused creates products that primarily support Alchemy and Culinary in crafting potions and cuisines that enhance combat performance.
Regular creates products that are primarily refined through Artisanry, Weaving, Alchemy, and Culinary. Their processed forms become essential resources for crafting gem inlays, gear, clothing dyes, furniture, bait, and other items.
101.Name: Botany

102.Des:
[Skill Build]
Focused products primarily used by Smelting to craft consumables for gear refinement.
Regular products are primarily refined through Smelting, Alchemy, and Culinary. Their processed forms become essential resources for crafting gear, furniture, cuisine, and other items.
102.Name: Mineralogy

103.Des:
[Skill Build]
Focused products primarily used by Gemcrafting to craft gem inlays for gear.
Regular products are primarily refined through Gemcrafting, Alchemy, and Culinary. Their processed forms become essential resources for crafting gear, dye sprays, furniture, cuisine, toys, and other items.
103.Name: Gemology

201.Des:
[Skill Build]
Focused creates recipes that include attribute-enhancing cuisine and Cheer-Up Treats. The materials required for crafting these items are primarily sourced from Botany and Fishing.
Regular creates recipes that can be used to craft bait, fertilizer, and other items. The materials required for crafting these items are primarily gathered through Botany and Fishing, or further processed via the Culinary.
201.Name: Culinary

202.Des:
[Skill Build]
Focused creates recipes that are primarily used for crafting Healing Aromatics, transformation potions, and dye sprays. The materials required for crafting these items are primarily sourced from Botany and Gemology.
Regular creates recipes that are primarily used for crafting homestead construction materials, Plants, pottery furniture, glass furniture, toys, and other items intended for non-trading purposes. The required materials are primarily gathered through Botany and Gemology, or further processed via Alchemy.
202.Name: Alchemy

203.Des:
[Skill Build]
The Focused is primarily used for crafting Mystery Metals and Radiant Stones. The materials required for crafting these items are primarily sourced from Mineralogy and Artisanry.
The Regular is primarily used for crafting certain weapons, heavy armor, homestead construction materials, and metal furniture, and other items. The materials required for crafting these items are primarily gathered through Mineralogy, or further processed via Smelting, Gemcrafting, Alchemy, and other professions.
203.Name: Smelting

204.Des:
[Skill Build]
The Focused is primarily used for crafting Ruby and Sapphire. The materials required for crafting these items are primarily sourced from Gemology and Artisanry.
The Regular is primarily used for crafting accessory-type gear, homestead construction materials, stone furniture, decorative gems, etc. The materials required for crafting these items are primarily gathered through Gemology, or further processed via Gemcrafting, Smelting, Alchemy, and other professions.
204.Name: Gemcrafting

205.Des:
[Skill Build]
The Focused is mainly used to craft key materials like Burning Powder for foundry refinement and gem wax for gem processing. The materials required for crafting these items are primarily sourced from Botany and Artisanry.
The Regular is primarily used for crafting certain weapons, homestead construction materials, wooden furniture, and other items. Crafting materials are primarily acquired through exchanges with Artisanry tutors, harvested via Botany, and further refined through Artisanry, Alchemy, Smelting, and other professions.
205.Name: Artisanry

206.Des:
[Skill Build]
The Focused is primarily used to craft vibrant Dyes that infuse garments with rich color. The materials required for crafting are primarily sourced from Botany and Alchemy classes.
Basic Recipe is primarily used for crafting medium armor, light armor, charm, homestead construction materials, cloth/leather furniture, etc. The materials required for crafting are primarily sourced from Botany, gathering, and hunting classes, or further processed via the Weaving, Culinary, and Smelting classes.
206.Name: Weaving
